test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Robe
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4) i.e. "**Cloak**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Robe**: (रोब) - A long, flowing outer garment.

 
 
• **Example**: The judge wore a black robe in the courtroom.
 
 
 
• **Cloak**: (चोगा) - A type of loose outer garment, similar to a robe, that covers the body.
 
 
• **Example**: She draped a thick cloak around her shoulders to keep warm.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Cloak**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robbery**: (लूट) - The action of robbing a person or place.
 
• **Mishap**: (दुर्घटना) - An unfortunate accident.
 
• **Success**: (सफलता) - The accomplishment of an aim or purpose.
